metaDescription: Discover why your business needs a firewall with our interactive assessment tool. Get personalized security recommendations based on your specific risks.

hero.headline: How secure is your network? Find out in two minutes.
hero.pageHeadlineAlt: Seven questions, about two minutes, no email needed.
hero.sub: Seven questions, about two minutes, no email needed. You get a risk score, the threats that matter in your industry, your main gaps and what to do next.
hero.quizFooterNote: Answer honestly to receive the most accurate analysis of your current security posture.

questions.question: What type of business do you run?
How many employees does your organization have?
questions.riskNote: As your team grows, so does your attack surface. Each employee represents a potential entry point for attackers.

questions.question: Does your business store customer data (emails, phone numbers, payment information)?
options: No, we don't store customer data
questions.riskNote: Storing customer data without adequate protection increases breach risk by 10x and may subject you to regulatory penalties.

questions.question: Do employees access company data remotely or work from home?
options: No, all work is done on-site
questions.riskNote: Remote work creates multiple unsecured access points to your network. Without proper protection, attackers can exploit these vulnerabilities.

questions.question: Has your organization experienced any cyber attacks or data breaches in the past?
options: No, not that we're aware of
questions.riskNote: 60% of businesses that experience one cyber attack are targeted again within 6 months. Your risk is significantly elevated.

questions.question: Do your employees use public Wi-Fi or unsecured networks for work?
questions.riskNote: Public Wi-Fi is a prime target for man-in-the-middle attacks. Hackers can intercept data transmitted over these networks without proper protection.

questions.question: Do you have dedicated IT personnel handling cybersecurity?
options: Yes, we have dedicated IT security staff
No, we don't have dedicated security personnel
We outsource IT / I'm not sure
questions.riskNote: Businesses without dedicated security personnel take 3x longer to detect breaches, increasing potential damage.

scoring.note: Score starts at 5 (out of 10). Storing customer data, remote access, a previous attack or public Wi-Fi use raises it; healthcare, finance and larger teams add weight. 8+ reads High, 5-7 Medium, below that Low.

levels.narrative: Your score suggests several gaps worth fixing. Here is where to start.

resultsPage.headline: Your Digital Security Report
resultsPage.sub: Your answers, scored openly. Below: your risk picture, the threats that matter in your industry, and what to do next.

riskFactorCards.title: Customer Data Risk
riskFactorCards.desc: Your business stores sensitive customer information, making you a high-value target for data theft.

riskFactorCards.title: Remote Access Vulnerabilities
riskFactorCards.desc: Remote work creates additional entry points for attackers to compromise your network.

riskFactorCards.title: Unsecured Connection Risk
riskFactorCards.desc: Using public WiFi exposes sensitive communications to potential interception.

riskFactorCards.title: Security Resource Gap
riskFactorCards.desc: Without dedicated security personnel, critical vulnerabilities may go undetected.

riskFactorCards.title: Recurring Attack Risk
riskFactorCards.desc: Organizations previously attacked are often targeted again, especially if vulnerabilities remain.

riskFactorCards.title: Network Perimeter Exposure
riskFactorCards.desc: Without proper firewall protection, your network perimeter is exposed to constant probing and attacks.

riskFactorCards.title: Business Continuity Risk
riskFactorCards.desc: Security incidents can cause significant downtime, affecting your operations and customer trust.

ecommerce.title: Payment Card Data Theft
ecommerce.desc: eCommerce businesses are prime targets for attackers seeking to steal customer payment information.

ecommerce.title: Shopping Cart Exploits
ecommerce.desc: Vulnerabilities in shopping cart software can be exploited to redirect payments or steal customer data.

healthcare.title: Patient Data Breaches
healthcare.desc: Hospitals hold sensitive health records that must stay private and in India.

healthcare.title: Ransomware Targeting
healthcare.desc: Medical facilities are frequent ransomware targets because downtime stops care.

financial.title: Financial Fraud
financial.desc: Financial institutions face sophisticated attacks targeting monetary transfers and customer accounts.

financial.title: Regulatory Compliance Risk
financial.desc: Financial organizations must meet strict security requirements or face significant penalties.

education.title: Student Data Exposure
education.desc: Educational institutions store sensitive student information that requires protection.

education.title: Research Theft
education.desc: Universities conducting valuable research are targets for intellectual property theft.

retail.title: POS System Attacks
retail.desc: Physical retail locations face risks to their point-of-sale systems and payment processing.

retail.title: Customer Loyalty Data
retail.desc: Customer loyalty programs contain valuable personal data that attackers target.

manufacturing.title: Intellectual Property Theft
manufacturing.desc: Manufacturing processes and designs are valuable targets for corporate espionage.

manufacturing.title: Operational Technology Risk
manufacturing.desc: Connected manufacturing equipment can be vulnerable to attacks that disrupt production.

saas.title: Customer Instance Breaches
saas.desc: SaaS companies risk exposing multiple customers' data in a single breach.

saas.title: API Vulnerabilities
saas.desc: Insecure APIs can provide attackers with access to sensitive backend systems.

default.title: Data Theft
default.desc: All businesses face risks of sensitive data being compromised.

default.title: Business Disruption
default.desc: Cyber attacks can disrupt operations and cause costly downtime.
